newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at steady to lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at steady to lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to lower levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded on Wednesday versus one on Tuesday. Bids and offers included:
- One barge, this week, Mississippi (St. Louis) offered at 200 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois offered at 232-1/2 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, next week, mid-Mississippi offered at 235 percent, no bid or comparison.
- One barge, on station, Illinois (Hennepin) offered at a steady 230 percent, no bid.
- Two barges, week of October 27, mid-Mississippi bid five points lower at 230 percent, offered at 240 percent.
- Four barges, two each weeks of November 3 and 10, mid-Mississippi bid 7-1/2 points lower at 210 percent, offered at 230 percent.
- Four barges, one each week December, Illinois, bid at 165 percent, offered at 175 percent, no comparison.
